hero.title: Artificial Intelligence Systems
hero.description: This module explores structured AI integration, streaming pipelines, memory systems and retrieval-based architectures. Intelligence is treated as a system layer, not a feature.

modules.title: Transformers
modules.description: Visual educational module explaining the architecture behind modern LLMs: attention, layers, positional encoding, and next-token prediction.

modules.title: Web Scraping with AI
modules.description: Automated data extraction from web sources using AI-driven techniques.

modules.title: Multi-Modal AI SDK Demos
modules.description: Demonstration of multi-modal AI capabilities, including text, image, and audio processing.

modules.title: Pipelines Architecture
modules.description: Design and implementation of AI pipelines for efficient data processing and model deployment.

modules.title: Tokenizer Playground
modules.description: Interactive environment for experimenting with different tokenization strategies and their effects on AI model performance.

modules.title: Quantization Playground
modules.description: Hands-on exploration of model quantization techniques to optimize AI models for deployment on resource-constrained devices.

modules.title: Embeddings Lab
modules.description: Experimental space for testing and visualizing embeddings generated by AI models, facilitating better understanding of model behavior and data representation.

modules.title: Autoregressive Inference Token-by-Token
modules.description: Step-by-step demonstration of autoregressive inference processes, showcasing how AI models generate outputs sequentially based on prior context.

modules.title: Token Prediction
modules.description: Interactive module for predicting the next token in a sequence, illustrating the predictive capabilities of AI language models.

modules.title: RAG Workbench
modules.description: Interactive retrieval augmented generation lab for chunking documents, retrieving top-k context, injecting evidence, and answering with citations.
